english.note: Use this for an intense emotional state in which someone loses ordinary self-control or rational detachment.

examples.english: They danced into a state of ecstasy and completely ignored even the audience.
examples.traditional: 佢跳舞跳到完全進入忘我狀態，連觀眾都唔理。
